> **This repository does not accept unsolicited pull requests, including documentation and typo fixes.** Outside pull requests are closed automatically without review.
>
> Send a reproducible defect to the [bug report form](https://github.com/dvmkit/dvm-cli/issues/new/choose), a feature or design question to [Discussions](https://github.com/dvmkit/dvm-cli/discussions), and a suspected vulnerability through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/dvmkit/dvm-cli/security/advisories/new). [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) explains why a reproduction is worth more to us than a patch.
>
> Delete this block if you are a maintainer working from a branch in this repository.

## Issue

Closes #

## User-visible change

Describe the observable effect.

## Verification

List the commands run after the final edit and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] This change comes from a same-repository maintainer or release-automation branch.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behaviour, or this change alters no behaviour.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, or none was affected.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, wallet material, job tokens, real payment data, or customer data.
